name: Fantastic Bullets (Combat)
body:
Your ability to imagine weaponry is not limited to melee weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Wondrous arsenal racial trait, base attack bonus +1

Benefit(s): You can use your wondrous arsenal racial trait to conjure ranged weapons. Reloading a weapon takes the same action as normal, but you conjure regular ammunition for the weapon as needed to reload. Your conjured weapons are no longer dismissed if you are not holding them.
